title: Mask Atlas rule file
description: Adds paths to the built-in profile of Mask Atlas, changes the kind of a path or switches a built-in path off. The first rule that matches a field wins.

version.description: The version of the rule file format.

format.description: The message format the rule applies to.

path.description: HL7: SEG-field or SEG-field.component (Z* for every Z segment), for example ZPD-5 or PID-5.2. X12: SEG-NN with an optional element test, for example NM1-09 or NM1[NM101=IL]-09. FHIR: dotted element names without indexes, for example Patient.contact.name.text, or *.note.text, or just the last names such as valueString.

kind.description: keep switches a built-in path off; free-text reads the value as running text; the other kinds replace the value as described in the documentation.

dateFormat.description: Only for kind date: the layout of the value (hl7: YYYYMMDD[HHMMSS], iso: YYYY-MM-DD, d8: CCYYMMDD, rd8: CCYYMMDD-CCYYMMDD, yymmdd).
